'''CT-1477''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']]. CT-1477 was patrolling the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], when he encountered young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Noticing that Fett was alone, he contacted another [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to retrieve Fett from the core room. While doing so, Fett asked CT-1477 what type of [[DC-15S/Legends|blaster]] he was carrying, and the clone allowed Fett to hold onto it. This proved to be a mistake. With the clone’s back turned, Boba struck the clone with the blaster, using it like a club. The first blow grazed the back of the clone’s helmet. Stunned, he turned around, only to be struck in the face. Dazed, the clone collapsed to one knee, when Fett bashed him in the face again, striking the helmet off of his head and sending him to the floor. Lying flat on his back, the clone saw Boba standing over him, with the blaster aimed at him. The clone begged for his life, temporarily distracting Fett. The trooper kicked at the young Fett, but was not quick enough. Fett grabbed the blaster before the clone could reach it, and stunned the trooper. Fett left the clone on the floor of the reactor room as he destroyed it. 

==Personality and traits==
A dedicated soldier, CT-1477 cared for the safety of his brothers, attempting to call in a fellow trooper to escort Fett. He also let Fett hold his DC-15A, telling him to keep the safety on. He additionally tried to reason with Fett, only attacking him when it was clear that young Fett would pull the trigger. The trooper was clearly shocked and hurt by Fett’s betrayal and disdain towards him. CT-1477 didn't mean to cause any intentional harm to Boba Fett, but Fett later stunned the trooper, leaving him knocked out while he destroyed the reactor.

Despite being trained in various types of combat, the clone was slow to react and was no match for Boba Fett. He was quickly defeated and rendered unconscious by the young Fett. He allowed Fett to strike him three times and was sent to the ground before even comprehending the situation.
